llm.summary: This skill is a Chinese K12 tutor reporting assistant that reads scoped student learning records to draft renewal reports, with consent checks and manual sending controls.

dimensions.detail: The sensitive access is proportionate to the task: it reads selected student learning and consent fields for one named learner, avoids real names/contact/family details, and requires authorization before parent-visible output.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is Markdown and JSON schema content only; no install scripts, executable files, dependency fetches, remote payloads, or tool-wrapping behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Some trigger examples are broad, but the skill repeatedly requires a specific student alias and report or renewal intent before reading records, and instructs the agent to ask for clarification rather than scan the workspace.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill can write confirmed report evidence to workspace.progressEvidence[] and delete only its own stage-report records after confirmation; it explicitly does not send messages, alter student cards, change consent, modify course ledgers, or delete full student files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose is to generate stage reports and renewal talking points from existing lesson, homework, package, consent, and progress evidence records; that capability matches the artifact text.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only for the intended Chinese K12 independent-teacher workflow. It handles minors' longitudinal learning records, so confirm the workspace consent fields are accurate, use aliases, and localize language, curriculum, law, and emergency-help channels before using it outside Mainland China.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The top-level description includes common teacher phrases, but the same description and main instructions require a named student before report generation, so this is an invocation-quality caution rather than a security concern.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger table is broad, but the following minimum-condition rule requires one concrete student and explicit report or renewal intent; casual discussion should get a clarification or ordinary answer without reading records.
[SQP-3] expected: The renewal scripts are in Chinese because the package is scoped to Chinese-language K12 tutoring and Mainland China defaults; this is disclosed rather than hidden behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: The AI-item-check instructions use Chinese labels in a Chinese educational workflow; no evidence shows deceptive output-language control or unrelated authority.
[SQP-3] expected: The platform conventions explicitly state the Mainland China Chinese K12 scope and require localization before other deployments, which supports rather than undermines disclosure.
